AnimaPromptPlus.description: Build a complete prompt from editable quality, artist, character, clothing, pose, background, and extra prompt sections, filled through one prompt selector that switches between the tag sections.

quality_prompt.name: Quality Prompt
quality_prompt.tooltip: Leading quality and style prompt text. This is placed before all selected tag sections.

artist_tags.name: Artist Tags
artist_tags.tooltip: Artist style tags filled by the Artist Selector or edited manually. Output is normalized as @artist.

character_tags.name: Character Tags
character_tags.tooltip: Character prompt tags filled by the Character Selector or edited manually.

clothing_tags.name: Clothing Tags
clothing_tags.tooltip: Clothing prompt tags filled by the Clothing Selector or edited manually.

pose_tags.name: Pose Tags
pose_tags.tooltip: Pose prompt tags filled by the Pose Selector or edited manually.

background_tags.name: Background Tags
background_tags.tooltip: Background prompt tags filled by the Background Selector or edited manually.

extra_prompt.name: Extra Prompt
extra_prompt.tooltip: Additional prompt text appended after all selected tag sections.

separator.name: Separator
separator.tooltip: The delimiter used to join cleaned prompt parts. Defaults to ', '.

AnimaPromptComposer.description: Randomly draw artist, character, clothing, background, and pose prompt tags from the full built-in data range at workflow runtime.

enable_artist.name: Enable Artist
enable_artist.tooltip: When disabled, artist candidates are ignored and not included in the output.

enable_character.name: Enable Character
enable_character.tooltip: When disabled, character candidates are ignored and not included in the output.

enable_clothing.name: Enable Clothing
enable_clothing.tooltip: When disabled, clothing candidates are ignored and not included in the output.

enable_background.name: Enable Background
enable_background.tooltip: When disabled, background candidates are ignored and not included in the output.

enable_pose.name: Enable Pose
enable_pose.tooltip: When disabled, pose candidates are ignored and not included in the output.

character_detail.name: Character Detail
character_detail.tooltip: Choose whether character output uses only the trigger, the trigger plus every feature tag, or the trigger plus a random slice of the feature tags.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Use -1 for a fresh random result each run, or a fixed number for reproducible random selection.

artist_count.name: Artist Count
artist_count.tooltip: Number of random artists to use. Character, clothing, background, and pose always select one each when enabled.

character_seed.name: Character Seed
character_seed.tooltip: Use -1 to follow the main seed, or a fixed number to lock the character on its own while the rest keeps rerolling.

character_tag_count.name: Character Tag Count
character_tag_count.tooltip: In "Trigger + Random Tags" mode, how many of the character's remaining feature tags are drawn at random.

character_keep_features.name: Keep Character Features
character_keep_features.tooltip: Keeps the character's hair and eye identity tags right after the trigger. Competing colours of the same attribute are collapsed to a single pick and gender words are never added.

clothing_seed.name: Clothing Seed
clothing_seed.tooltip: Use -1 to follow the main seed, or a fixed number to lock the outfit on its own while the rest keeps rerolling.

clothing_source.name: Clothing Source
clothing_source.tooltip: Author gallery: use the bundled clothing gallery. Danbooru tag groups: pick one of top+bottom, uniform or traditional wear, then layer decoration, socks and shoes on top. Character tags: borrow the wearable tags of another character. Random source: pick one of the three at random each run.

AnimaMultiLoraLoader.description: Load and apply multiple local LoRAs selected with the Anima LoRA manager.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: The model that receives the enabled LoRAs in top-to-bottom order.

lora_list_json.name: LoRA List
lora_list_json.tooltip: Serialized LoRA configuration managed by the LoRA Manager popup.
